# name: TE trên HTTP/1.0
# expect: 400
# source: RFC 9112 §6.1: 'A server MUST NOT send TE in response to HTTP/1.0'; client 1.0 không có chunked
# why: HTTP/1.0 không định nghĩa chunked; backend 1.0 đọc CL/EOF, proxy đọc chunked ⇒ lệch
---
POST / HTTP/1.0\r\n
Host: h\r\n
Transfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n
\r\n
0\r\n
\r\n
